map.WGS84 椭球横轴墨卡托投影：k₀=0.9996、长半轴 a=6378137: WGS84 ellipsoidal transverse Mercator projection: k₀=0.9996, semi-major axis a=6378137 m, flattening f=1/298.257223563; results are converted to the specified UTM zone (6° each), with a false northing of 0/10000000 m for the northern/southern hemisphere.
map.UTM带内的位置精度通常在厘米级，但带边缘变形增大。跨带使用需注意精度损失。: Positional accuracy within a UTM zone is usually centimeter-level, but distortion grows at zone edges. Note the accuracy loss when crossing zones.
map.全球分为60个带，每带宽6度经度: The globe is divided into 60 zones, each 6° of longitude wide
map.东移假值 = 500000 m（中央经线以东为正）: False easting = 500000 m (positive east of the central meridian)
map.北移假值 = 0 m（赤道），南半球加 10000000 m: False northing = 0 m (equator); add 10000000 m in the southern hemisphere
map.UTM坐标精度取决于投影变形，边缘区域误差增大: UTM coordinate accuracy depends on projection distortion; error grows near zone edges
map.本工具使用简化的横轴墨卡托投影公式，适用于一般精度需求（米级）。高精度测绘请使用: This tool uses simplified transverse Mercator formulas, suitable for general (meter-level) accuracy needs. For high-precision surveying, use professional GIS software.
map.GIS 数据在不同坐标系之间转换以统一量算口径。: Convert GIS data between coordinate systems to unify measurement.
map.(39.90°N,116.40°E) → UTM 50N 带：东移 449,34: (39.90°N,116.40°E) → UTM zone 50N: easting 449,345 m (including the 500 km false easting), northing 4,417,292 m.
map.UTM 为何分带？: Why is UTM divided into zones?
map.减小投影变形，每 6° 一带。: To reduce projection distortion, one zone per 6°.
map.UTM 和经纬度哪个更好用？: UTM or lat/lon: which is better?
map.小范围内 UTM 便于按米量距；跨带使用时需换带，否则变形增大。: Over small areas UTM makes measuring in meters easy; when crossing zones you must re-zone, otherwise distortion grows.
